profile.headline: Software Engineer who loves the craft and learning new things
profile.summary:
I am a Full Stack .NET Developer with experience in  C#, ASP.NET, MVC, Web API, Entity Framework, SQL, SQL Server, HTML5, CSS 3,  JavaScript,  AngularJS, Angular 2+, jQuery, Scrum and REST. I am currently working as a Junior .Net developer creating great web applications for business clients that harness client data and makes actionable information to help businesses succeed.
I have always enjoyed helping people solve problems and I now get to use software development to extend this passion. My goal is to become an expert software engineer that enhances the experience for users. I am building my experience base and learning industry wide best practices in order to excel in this craft.
View examples of my code @ https://github.com/anwarjones!

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: As an Associate Software Engineer, I wrote code in C# and MSSql to improve internal tools and resolve bugs. I also had the opportunity to work as team lead for quarterly hackathons for adding features to internal tools. My daily activities consisted of performing root cause analysis and identifying problem areas in C# production code to resolve an average of 5 issues per week. As a debugging expert, I performed trouble shooting on software errors in production code that was written with code built in C#, ASP.NET, HTML and CSS, and SQL and Mongo databases. This included working through SSIS packages. I communicated with internal clients on resolving issues and ensuring client facing teams had adequate information and tools to meet external client needs. Additionally, I volunteered to work on a team to lead in building a strategy around enterprise software alerts.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science · Problem Solving

positions.title: .Net Developer
positions.description:
Maintained existing application code by updating code that may have broken due to changes in the business or that needed to be updated with newer features.  
Wrote code to allow for different vendor applications to be integrated across all systems.
Created green field applications when staff, teachers or students needed new functionality.
Worked as part of an Agile software team to meet client and business needs.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science · Problem Solving

positions.title: .Net Developer
positions.description:
As a .Net Developer/ consultant I help Booz Allen serve our clients. I have created a marketing product showcasing open data and visualization tools and integrating HTML and AngularJS based charting tools. 
Utilizing my diverse career backgrounds, I also assist the data governance team in improving data quality. I'm also working with a cross disciplinary team to evaluate and strategize around the organization's software architectural processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science · Problem Solving

positions.title: Junior .Net Developer
positions.description: I develop software solutions to capitalize on client data and create useful and dynamic views that organizations can use to get a better understanding of their business as well as to plan for success. I utilize technologies in C#, VB.Net, ASP.Net, Angularjs, javascript, HTML, CSS, ASP.Net webforms and ASP.Net WebApi. Each day I have the pleasure of thinking through problems of various complexity and designing the best solution that I can to accomplish my and IDS' goals.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Computer Science · Problem Solving

positions.title: Financial Coach
positions.description:
As a financial coach, I work with low to moderate income individuals and families.  My mission is to help them improve their economic situation. This is accomplished through one on one coaching and developing curricula for financial education workshops and lectures.

Helped clients set financial goals and provided them with materials to help them map out strategies for achieving those goals.
Worked with clients to help them develop a budget and taught them how to regularly review their progress
Reviewed credit reports and credit scores with clients. Provided them with feedback on their credit history and gave them strategies for improving their credit profile.
Assisted clients in a wide range of household issues that affected their finances often helping clients navigate complex processes in order to help them achieve success.
Coached clients through the behavior change processes to help them increase their likelihood for success.

company.name: Catholic Charities of Kansas City-St. Joseph

positions.title: Field Ombudsman
positions.description:
As a community ombudsman for the Green Impact Zone/Mid America Regional Council, my role included outreach to members of the community that we served. I created marketing material including telephone call scripts, flyer and inserts, powerpoint presentations etc. I also presented information orally to community members at monthly neighborhoodassociation meetings. 
I worked as part of a planning team for the Green Impact Zone's summer youth program. I administered daily operational tasks for the summer. I selected and secured enrichment activities for the youth to help increase their exposure to various career fields and study
fields.
Working in various assigned focus areas I created and implemented programming to educate and expose residents of the Green Impact Zone with the goal of increasing knowledge or exposure to ideas. The topics of classes or workshops covered public safety, urban agriculture, financial
literacy and workforce development. 
I worked with partner organizations within Kansas City to secure resources and program elements to enhance the lives of residents of Green Impact Zone neighborhoods. I was able to work
with partner organizations to bring an urban agriculture program to residents. I built relationships with members of the KCMO police department and helped to negotiate the return of the Citizens Police Academy to the urban core of Kansas City making it available to a wider range of
residents.
I performed research duties in the assigned focus areas to find best practices and program ideas to enhance the work of the Green Impact Zone. I found an environmental literacy curriculum, and worked to secure funding to have our staff trained and licensed to deliver this curriculum
to residents of Kansas City.

positions.title: Store Manager
positions.description: I worked as a store manager for RadioShack.  I handled daily operations and coached my associates on sales techniques to increase sales and profitability.  We were able to increase sales over the 2nd quarter of 2008.

positions.title: Team Leader
positions.description: I was the leader of teams of auditors of varying sizes.  I delegated responsibilities, coached associates on efficient and accurate counting techniques.  I developed several auditors into assistant team leaders and team leaders.  I received several perfect inventory reports and created strong teams that finished counts quickly and accurately.

volunteerExperiences.description: Work with teams of volunteers to create software minimally viable products that meet local civic and community organizations needs.

projects.title: Mid America Regional Council - The Green Impact Zone
projects.description: Facilitated the revitalization of 150 square blocks in the urban core of Kansas City that had experienced 40+ years of disinvestment. This was accomplished via outreach and engagement activities associated with 8 strategies: employment & training, housing, public safety & community service, energy & water conservation, weatherization, urban agriculture and youth. The supervision of four neighborhood ombudsman and 2 administrative support staff was critical to ensuring the revitalization process was guided by leaders and residents of the six neighborhoods who were at the heart of the revitalization process.
